page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores utilizing the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong CPU and memory performance. The instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, alongside high passmark CPU and memory scores. Cryptographic capabilities are supported by hardware-accelerated AES and VAES instructions, resulting in strong performance in encryption benchmarks. While cached memory bandwidth is highly efficient, uncached large-block memory read and write speeds remain in the average tier. Database and caching performance are highlighted by strong Redis SET operations, reaching 61.54 million operations per second, though standard database operations and static web serving throughput fall within average parameters.

Given its high resource density and dedicated AMD EPYC cores, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. It is highly suited for large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, multi-threaded data decompression, and memory-heavy analytical processing. The absence of local storage and GPUs makes it less suitable for direct storage-heavy database clustering or hardware-accelerated machine learning training, but it remains a robust option for memory-bound enterprise applications and small-model LLM inference.
